data.title: Speed challenge: is the password long enough?
story: Write a function long_enough(password) that returns True if the password has at least 8 characters.
Spaces at the start and end do not count. There are hidden tests for empty text, exactly 8 characters, and passwords with spaces!

explanation: Remove the spaces around it with .strip(), then compare its length using len(...) >= 8. The >= sign matters so a password of exactly 8 characters is accepted too.
hints: You can get the length of a text with len(...).
"At least 8" means 8 is fine too. Do you use > or >=?
Spaces at the start and end can be removed with .strip() before counting.
